name: Snickers
ingredients: Milk chocolate coating (38%): Sugar, Milk solids, Cocoa butter, Cocoa solids, Edible vegetable fats <5% (Sal fat, Palm oil), Dextrose, Emulsifier (INS 322); Centre filling (62%): Liquid glucose, Peanuts (16%), Sugar, Hydrogenated vegetable oil (Palm oil), Milk solids, lodized salt, Cocoa butter, Cocoa solids Edible vegetable fats <5% (Sal fat, Palm oil), Dextrose, Emulsifier (INS 322). CONTAINS VEGETABLE FAT IN ADDITION TO COCOA BUTTER. Contains Peanuts, Milk, Soy. May contain Tree Nuts.
